headline: [New Twist!] Trump Says [Tim Cook] Should Replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO
sub: Huang agrees to testify before Congress
caption:
💻 Trump says Tim Cook should lead Nvidia

US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that Apple's Tim Cook should become the new CEO of Nvidia, after Jensen Huang stepped down. In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote that there is "only one man" to take Huang's place and called it "A Legend replaces a Legend!"

🔹 Nvidia has named its finance chief, Colette Kress, as interim CEO while its board looks for a permanent leader.
🔹 Tim Cook stepped down as Apple CEO in September and is now executive chairman of Apple's board.
🔹 Huang has agreed to testify before US lawmakers in a closed-door session by Thanksgiving, House Foreign Affairs Committee chairman Brian Mast said.

💬 Who do you think should lead Nvidia next? 👇

Sources: NBC News, Fox Business, TechCrunch

headline: [Tensions Rise!] Iran Says It Hit a [US Radar] in Bahrain
sub: The claim has not been independently verified
caption:
⚠️ Iran Says It Hit a US Radar in Bahrain

Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC) said on Friday that they targeted and destroyed a US early-warning radar in Bahrain. Iran's state news agency IRNA reported the statement. AP and Al Jazeera said the claim could not be independently verified, and the US and Bahrain did not comment straight away.

🔹 The IRGC said it was a reply to an attack on a telecom tower in Sirik, a port city in southern Iran, on Thursday.
🔹 According to Reuters, it is Iran's first claimed attack on US military assets in a Gulf country since early September.
🔹 Bahrain hosts the headquarters of the US Navy's Fifth Fleet. The IRGC warned it is ready to act again.

💬 Do you think talks can stop the tension from growing? 👇

Sources: AP, Al Jazeera, Reuters

#GlobalEye #Iran #Bahrain #USA #MiddleEast #WorldNews
photo_needed: A US military radar or US Navy base in Bahrain, or an IRGC missile launch photo. A map-style image of Bahrain and Iran also works (no people needed).
